title: HVAC Maintenance Agreements Terms of Renewal, Expiry, Cancellation and Transfer
content:
Renewal, expiry, cancellation, refund and transfer terms of the HVAC Maintenance Agreements (all Bridgewell Comfort Care levels). All day counts are calendar days.

## Renewal and expiry

R1. An agreement with automatic renewal renews on its term end only when the renewal notice was issued at least 30 calendar days before the term end date; counting runs backward from the term end date and a notice issued exactly that many days before qualifies.

R2. Otherwise it expires at the end of the term end date; within 30 calendar days after the term end date the customer may re-enroll without a new qualifying inspection.

R3. On renewal the agreement enters a new term starting the day after the prior term end date; the unused visits of the old term are forfeited and a new allotment is granted.

The renewal notice date and the term end date are read from the company's agreement record.

| Term end date (hypothetical) | Renewal notice issued | Days before term end | Automatic renewal agreement |
|---|---|---|---|
| 30 June | 31 May | 30 | Renews; a notice exactly 30 days before qualifies |
| 30 June | 15 May | 46 | Renews |
| 30 June | 1 June | 29 | Does not renew; expires at the end of 30 June |
| 30 June | none issued | none | Does not renew; expires at the end of 30 June |

## Cancellation by the customer

C1. The customer may cancel at any time; cancellation is effective on the notice date.

C2. Within 30 calendar days after the start date the customer is credited the fees paid in the term less the level's visit retail value for each completed visit. The days are counted from the day after the start date through the notice date, both included; a notice on the 30th such day is within the period. The fees paid in the term are the membership payments posted in the current term up to the notice date, less returned payments billed back in that period, and the completed visits are the tune-ups completed in the current term.

C3. Afterwards an annual agreement is credited the same amount less the cancellation admin fee of 25.00, the visits already received being the value the customer has used; a monthly agreement stops billing and is credited nothing.

C4. A credit is never negative and is refunded within 30 calendar days.

C5. Only one cancellation credit is posted per agreement. Whether one has already been posted is read from the agreement's billing record.

| Notice date | Billing | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| Within the 30-day period after the start date | Monthly or annual | Fees paid in the term less the visit retail value for each completed visit, never below zero |
| After that period | Annual | Fees paid in the term less the visit retail value for each completed visit less 25.00, never below zero |
| After that period | Monthly | Nothing; billing stops |

### Worked credits (hypothetical amounts)

Assume an annual agreement on which 279.00 was paid in the term and whose level's visit retail value is 149.00.

- Notice on day 20 after the start date, one completed visit: 279.00 less 149.00 gives a credit of 130.00.
- Notice on day 45 after the start date, one completed visit: 279.00 less 149.00 less 25.00 gives a credit of 105.00.
- Notice on day 20, two completed visits: 279.00 less 298.00 would fall below zero, so the credit is 0.00.

For a monthly agreement with 24.95 paid in the term and no completed visit, notice on day 10 gives a credit of 24.95; notice on day 45 gives no credit and billing stops.

Free-look boundary (hypothetical): start date 1 March; a notice on 31 March is day 30 and within the period; a notice on 1 April is day 31 and after it.

## Nonpayment

N1. A membership fee unpaid more than 30 calendar days after its due date cancels the agreement for nonpayment with no refund.

## Transfer

T1. When the level allows transfer, the agreement moves to a new owner of the property for the rest of the term. Every Bridgewell Comfort Care level allows transfer.
